summary: Iteration 7 StyleSheet/Image/type-safety fixes VERIFIED. All 5 requested checks PASS: (1) The reported 'Property StyleSheet doesn't exist' render error is GONE — web boot + login (budi@dompet.test/password123) succeed, all 5 tabs (Beranda, Riwayat, Tambah, Anggaran, Profil) render cleanly, screenshots collected. Zero StyleSheet errors, zero 'Render Error' pageerrors, zero 'Property ... doesn't exist' throws — only the expected push-relay 401 in console. (2) `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` exits with code 0 (100% clean). (3) Repo-wide grep of app/ and src/ for StyleSheet./Image usages/TextInputProps confirms every consuming file imports the identifier from react-native — zero undeclared uses. Specifically: ui.tsx now imports StyleSheet on line 2 (fixing the reported crash at line 215 `borderWidth: StyleSheet.hairlineWidth`); tambah.tsx now imports Image on line 2 (fixing the native crash on receipt <Image source={{uri:photoUri}}/>). (5) `bash /app/frontend/tests/verify_push_expo_go_safe.sh` PASSES both cases (Expo Go: module evaluates cleanly with proxy-throwing Notifications; native-build: setNotificationHandler + setNotificationChannelAsync invoked). Backend regression: 18/18 non-flaky pytest cases pass; 1 pre-existing flaky test (test_notification_created_for_partner asserts unread==0 but got 2 — leftover notifications from prior runs, NOT related to iter7).

tambah.tsx line 2: `import { Image, Linking, Platform, Pressable, ScrollView, Text, TextInput, View } from 'react-native'` — Image now properly imported before its usage at line 223 for the receipt preview.
tambah.tsx line 117: sourceSheet state type `useState<null | 'denied' | 'picker'>(null)` correctly widened to include 'picker' so the picker-sheet variant compiles.
app/_layout.tsx: nudgeStyles pattern converted to a hook call `useNudgeStyles()` inside AppChrome (component scope) rather than a top-level object access — respects hook rules.

app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx: NativeTabs Icon/Label destructured from NativeTabs.Trigger — matches the actual expo-router/unstable-native-tabs export shape in SDK 57 and avoids the iOS 26+ crash from importing non-existent named exports.

beranda/anggaran LineChart & PieChart props purged of unsupported keys (xAxisTextStyle/hideArrow/centerText) — replaced with per-item labelTextStyle and centerLabelComponent per react-native-gifted-charts current API.
theme.ts setColorScheme null->'unspecified' guard prevents a crash when Appearance.getColorScheme() returns null (initial render on some devices).
